about.heroSubtitle: Moreno Advisory helps companies find the right people, start better conversations, and create real commercial opportunities through strategic B2B prospecting.
about.story1: Moreno Advisory was founded by Carlos Eduardo Moreno after more than 7 years working with sales, business development, and B2B prospecting.
about.story2: After supporting companies through Fiverr and direct projects, Moreno Advisory was created to bring a more strategic and professional structure to the same work: helping businesses find the right people, start better conversations, and create real commercial opportunities.
about.story3: We are a founder-led advisory, which means every project is handled with close attention, transparency, and care.
about.missionText: To help B2B companies open qualified conversations with the right decision-makers through clear research, human outreach, and practical business development support.
about.visionText: To become a trusted founder-led advisory for companies that want practical, human, and organized support opening new commercial conversations.
about.valuesSubtitle: These values aren't aspirational statements on a wall — they are the operating principles that govern every engagement and every decision we make.
about.methodologySubtitle: A disciplined, proven approach that transforms ambition into measurable growth.
about.ctaText: Let's explore how Moreno Advisory can become the growth partner your business deserves.
about.founderSubtitle: Prospecting, LinkedIn Outreach and Practical Business Development
about.founderPara1: Founded by Carlos Eduardo Moreno, Moreno Advisory brings together more than 7 years of experience in sales, business development, and B2B prospecting.
about.founderPara2: After supporting companies through Fiverr and direct projects, Carlos created Moreno Advisory to offer a clearer, more strategic structure for the same kind of work: finding the right people, organizing outreach, and helping companies start better commercial conversations.
about.founderQuote: The goal is simple: help companies approach the right decision-makers with context, clarity, and a human message.
about.founderPara3: The advisory operates from Mairinque, São Paulo, Brazil, with close founder involvement, practical communication, and an international B2B market perspective.
